text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — elevated 5xx rate detected for service=model-runner-prod. 5m error rate=8.7% (baseline 0.3%). Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Pager triggered. Metrics: https://ops.metrics/alerts/3245678902

paul_oncall: I'm on call. grabbing logs and starting triage. Anyone from ML-runtime?

tara_sre: on it — checking node health + dmesg. quick ask: do we have recent deploys on that cluster?

jin_ml: no deploys in last 2 hours from model team. Last change was config tweak to quantization profiles yesterday.

tara_sre: I see repeated OOMs and a couple segfaults in the inference worker on gpu-23. Kernel logs: 
```
[ 1234.567890] Out of memory: Kill process 48291 (inference_worker) score 987 or sacrifice child
[ 1234.567890] inference_worker invoked oom-killer: gfp_mask=0x201da, order=0, oom_score_adj=0
[ 1234.567891] inference_worker(48291): segfault at 0 ip 0x7f1d... sp 0x7ffd... error 4 in libmodelkernels.so
```
Looks like paging thrash -> OOM -> segfault.

paul_oncall: customer impact? any 5xx spikes tied to specific customers?

lara_support: support console shows a spike in errors for 3 enterprise tenants in EU region — some 5xx and timeouts. I opened customer tickets for the top 2 affected accounts and posted the incident link.

jin_ml: possible culprit: recent quant kernel path can increase memory for long sequences. I'll revert kernel routing for the affected model variant to the stable path.

tara_sre: mitigation proposal: 1) divert traffic off gpu-23 / node group; 2) scale up replica count for model-runner-prod in eu-west; 3) enable fallback model variant (smaller quant) for heavy sequences; 4) throttle/prefetch long requests.

paul_oncall: do it. I'll start the handoff to infra to cordon the node.

deploy-bot: [deploy] scale up deployment model-runner-prod replicas from 8 -> 12 in eu-west: started.

tara_sre: cordoning node gpu-23 now: `kubectl cordon node/gpu-23 && kubectl drain node/gpu-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

jin_ml: rolling fallback: switching router policy for model-id=rw-large-quant -> rw-large-stable for requests with seq_len>2048. Patch: 
```json
{"routing": {"model_id": "rw-large-quant", "fallback": "rw-large-stable", "condition": "seq_len>2048"}}
```
Applied.

paul_oncall: I see error rate dropping to 2.1% in the last 2 minutes. Still above baseline but trending down.

tara_sre: Investigating root cause — capturing core dumps and uploading to S3. Also starting memory profiling on a staging copy.

lara_support: FYI — customers notified with interim update. No data exfiltration; just service errors/timeouts.

jin_ml: quick note: we'll disable the new quant attention kernel routing in prod until we validate memory bounds. Patching flag: `--kernsel=stable` for model-runner.

deploy-bot: [patch] set model-runner-prod args `--kernsel=stable` on 4/12 nodes: complete.

paul_oncall: Can SRE own node remediation? Tara?

tara_sre: yes. Node cordoned and drained. Pods rescheduled. We'll keep node offline and replace hardware if dmesg continues to show kernel-level panics.

jin_ml: I'll run through a targeted load test with long sequences on a staging replica to reproduce and capture memory profile.

paul_oncall: Summary update: mitigations applied -> traffic routed to stable kernel and fallback model for long seqs; node gpu-23 cordoned/drained; replicas scaled up; error rate down from 8.7% -> 1.8% over 10m. Customer impact: transient 5xx for three enterprise tenants (tickets opened). Next steps: (1) ML to validate kernel memory fix, (2) SRE to monitor node hardware and review OOM cause, (3) follow-up postmortem if root cause confirmed.

lara_support: I'll keep customers updated. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

tara_sre: leaving notes in incident tracker and assigning follow-ups: SRE action -> node hardware/oom trace, ML action -> revert/validate quant kernel, Oncall -> confirm full recovery.

paul_oncall: handing off to tara_sre for follow-up. Marking incident in progress -> monitoring. If error rate rises again, re-escalate pager.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=monitoring, severity=high, runbook=https://confluence/incidents/model-runtime-5xx-runbook, handoff_to=tara_sre

paul_oncall: closing active paging loop. Will re-open if we see recurrence. good job team.
